Two people got into a car accident at the corner today, one of the drivers was a 15 year old and the other driver a 66 year old. The 66 year old had been going 55mph in a 30mph zone and wasn't able to stop in time to avoid hitting the 15 year old when he came to a full stop at the stop sign. Who was acting responsibly?
A. Undetermined
B. The 66 year old
C. The 15 year old
